name: Sensible Portions Garden Veggie Straws (Sea Salt)
whyItWorks: Despite the 'veggie' marketing, these straws are primarily potato starch and corn flour tinted with tomato and spinach powders. They have a hollow airy tube shape that collapses easily upon chewing with zero whole vegetable fibers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: A light, crunchy, gluten-free snack with 30% less fat than standard potato chips.
watchOuts: Safe for remission and recovery; ensure adequate hydration.
